found.title: File:Dais and seating for Investiture of the Price of Wales - Caernarfon Castle - geograph.org.uk - 1606926.jpg
found.why: Category:Investiture of Charles, Prince of Wales (1969)
found.credit: From geograph.org.uk
found.desc: Dais and seating for Investiture of the Price of Wales - Caernarfon Castle. This rather foreshortened photograph was taken a month after the investiture of Price Charles as the Price of Wales on 1 July 1969. The slate dais under the canopy remains but the canopy and seating have long since been removed. See 65937 for a another view from the day before the investiture.
